import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ArbitraryPoleResidue
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LocalTaylorCoefficients
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4SimplePoleResidueField

/-!
# Parameter-dependent residues for arbitrary poles

Finite Taylor coefficients of a local parameter extract the coefficient of
`t⁻¹ dt` from a differential after clearing a chosen pole.  The construction
retains an explicit parameter; `Chapter4ResidueParameterChange` proves independence
of that parameter. The general global residue theorem is a separate producer.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

def curveParameterConstantTerm {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    X.left.presheaf.stalk x →ₗ[k] k :=
  (curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx).toLinearMap.comp
    ((Algebra.linearMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      (ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))).restrictScalars k)

theorem curveParameterConstantTerm_residue {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :
    residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      (algebraMap k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
        (curveParameterConstantTerm X hx a)) = residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) a := by
  change residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      (algebraMap k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
        (curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx (residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) a))) = _
  apply (curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx).injective
  change (curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx)
      (algebraMap k (ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
        (curveResidueFieldEquivBase X hx (residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) a))) = _
  rw [curveResidueFieldEquivBase_algebraMap]

/-- The base-field coefficient of order `n` after clearing a pole of order
`n + 1` with a specified local parameter. -/
def curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℕ) :
    curvePoleDifferentials X x (n + 1) →ₗ[k] k := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  let c0 : X.left.presheaf.stalk x →ₗ[k] k := curveParameterConstantTerm X hx
  let h : ∀ a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x,
      residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (algebraMap k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (c0 a)) =
        residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) a :=
    curveParameterConstantTerm_residue X hx
  let e : CurveStalkDifferentials X x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      X.left.presheaf.stalk x := curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht |>.symm
  let q := (curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht (n + 1)).restrictScalars k
  let e' := e.toLinearMap.restrictScalars k
  exact (localTaylorCoefficient c0 h t ht.ne_zero ht.maximalIdeal_eq n).comp (e'.comp q)

@[simp]
theorem curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℕ) (ω : curvePoleDifferentials X x (n + 1)) :
    letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
    curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht n ω =
      localTaylorCoefficient (curveParameterConstantTerm X hx)
        (curveParameterConstantTerm_residue X hx) t ht.ne_zero ht.maximalIdeal_eq n
        ((curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
          (curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht (n + 1) ω)) := by
  rfl

end
end Hartshorne
